name: Channel Requests
description: Lets non-admins request new channels for admin approval, with configurable naming rules and automatic member add.

settings_schema.header: Configure where channel-creation requests are sent for approval. Requests from non-admins are posted to this channel, where any System Admin can approve or deny them.

settings.help_text: The URL name (slug) of the team that contains the approval channel. For example, if the team URL is /myteam, enter 'myteam'.
The URL name (slug) of the channel where channel-creation requests are posted for approval. For example, if the channel URL is /myteam/channels/channel-requests, enter 'channel-requests'.

Optional. Forces every approved channel URL into a standard shape. Use '{{name}}' as a placeholder for the requester's slugified channel name. For example, 'team-{{name}}' turns a request for 'Marketing' into 'team-marketing'. Leave blank to use the requested name as-is.

Optional. A regular expression that the final channel URL must match, applied after the template. Requests that don't match are rejected with an explanation. Anchor with ^ and $ to match the whole URL. For example, '^team-[a-z0-9-]{2,}$'. Leave blank to allow any valid channel URL.
